# Audio Layout Checklist

## Generator Section
- Output device selector.
- Waveform selector.
- Frequency and amplitude controls.
- Start/Stop buttons with clear status.

## Analyzer Section
- Input device selector.
- Phase invert toggle.
- Start/Stop buttons with clear status.

## Charts
- Output signal chart.
- Input signal chart.
- Comparison chart.
- Consistent time window and trigger mode configuration.

## Stability
- Loop throttle and batching strategy documented.
- Sample-rate fallback result visible in UI or log.
